name: About
summary: Shows the firmware version, the hardware and the regulatory information.

name: Archive
summary: Browses the files saved by each app, by tab, and opens, renames or deletes them.

name: Bluetooth
summary: Turns Bluetooth on or off and forgets paired devices.

name: Clock & Alarm
summary: Sets the alarm and how the clock is shown.

name: Desktop
summary: Sets the PIN lock, the auto-lock delay and the desktop's quick access apps.

name: Expansion Modules
summary: Chooses which port an expansion module on the GPIO header may connect through.

name: Input
summary: Sets how the buttons react, such as vibration on each press.

name: JS Runner
summary: Runs JavaScript (.js) scripts opened from the Archive or the file browser.

name: MNTM
summary: Momentum's own settings: Interface, Protocols and Misc (the main menu's apps, the asset packs and more inside).

name: LCD and Notifications
summary: Sets the screen backlight, contrast, LED brightness, volume and vibration.

name: Passport
summary: Shows the dolphin's name, level, mood and experience.

name: Power
summary: Shows the battery, and reboots or powers off the Flipper.

name: Storage
summary: Shows the SD card's space, and mounts, unmounts, formats or benchmarks it.

name: Add Manually
summary: Sub-GHz's Add Manually: makes a saved signal from a chosen protocol and key, without receiving it.

name: System
summary: Sets the hand orientation, units, time and date format, log level and debug mode.
